description:
Glass panel theme layout with a suitable level of transparency. Three widget groups for easy editing, includes a full keyboard, for 4:3 tablet devices (layout position on other devices is not guaranteed)

This update's changes:

--- In-Game ---
1. Added TAB key (auto hold)
2. Adjusted more details (real changes, not filler :)

--- Out-of-Game ---
1. Added TAB key (no auto hold)
2. Fixed 100%-size keys accidentally using the 150% style
3. Adjusted more details (real changes, not filler :)

--- Full Keyboard ---
1. Changed font size to fix character overflow
2. Fixed the full keyboard not popping up correctly

--- Colors ---
Normal: 50% opacity black stained glass
Active: 50% opacity white stained glass
